summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Hands-on experience across robotics, embedded systems, and autonomous vehicle simulation, including root-causing integration failures from system logs and sensor data on Linux-based Jetson and STM32 platforms. Comfortable working independently through ambiguous, open-ended technical problems, from leading a 25-member robotics team to building and debugging a full autonomous pick-and-place system from scratch.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, sensor and PCB integration, and end-to-end system validation for locomotive robots.

Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback, debugging integration issues across mechanical, electrical, and software subsystems.
Ran 10+ technical workshops (Arduino, PCB design, SolidWorks) to build team-wide hardware skills, growing the club's structured build-test-debug capability.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Integrated ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth into a wearable gesture-recognition device, validating 3-DoF hand motion sensing against HID output through iterative on-hardware testing.
Diagnosed and resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning, debugging a custom z-axis differential tap-detection algorithm at the hardware/firmware level.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated and validated a multi-sensor pick-and-place system (dual VL53L0X ToF + camera fused via TCA9548A I2C mux) on a distributed Jetson+Arduino controller pipeline.

Diagnosed and resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) through log and behavior analysis; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Implemented contact-aware grasping via range-gated ToF sensing and closed-loop visual servoing (TensorRT-optimized YOLO) on embedded hardware in C++ and Python.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated CARLA data pipelines (~5,000 YOLO, ~3,000 UFLD frames, zero manual annotation) and trained an adaptive control stack for lane-following, waypoint fallback, and obstacle avoidance.
Validated the stack in Town02 against 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians, achieving zero collisions and correct traffic-light compliance across multiple test runs.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Built a YOLOv8-on-Jetson object detection and tracking pipeline sending real-time control commands to an STM32 over UART for closed-loop servo control.
Tuned multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART command handling and user override, validating controller response under live tracking conditions.
